sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Quinn Jay Adamson is an American Fork police lieutenant. This page includes his employment and compensation records and covers his involvement in two encounters documented on this site: the Ben Schneider (Reckless Ben) case and the arrest of Cody Greenland.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Quinn Jay Adamson began working for the American Fork Police Department on June 8, 2010. He was employed by the Provo City Constable’s Office from September 29, 2017, through October 11, 2018.

contents.text_value: Adamson took part in the March 2026 investigation involving Schneider and his associates. On March 11, he was involved in seizing Sheldon Norcross’s phone and arresting him after accusing him of attempting to destroy evidence. Norcross said he was pressing the power button to lock the phone as he handed it over. Later that day, Adamson participated in the Airbnb raid, updated Chief Cameron Paul and Sgt. Adam Stowers about the people detained, and coordinated their transport to the police department.

Adamson was among the officers involved in Greenland’s April 17, 2020 arrest. Greenland’s federal lawsuit alleged that Adamson used a Taser on him multiple times without warning and failed to stop another officer’s use of force. Adamson was named as a defendant. The lawsuit was later settled and dismissed with prejudice; the settlement did not establish that the allegations were proven.
